# Clean Room Wipes

> > Supplier of cleanroom consumables and ESD protection products including wipes, finger cots, anti-static apparel, sticky mats, and contamination control equipment for electronics and laboratory environments.

Clean Room Wipes specializes in cleanroom supplies and contamination control solutions for industries requiring dust-free, anti-static environments. Products feature materials like polyester, conductive fiber, and microfiber designed to meet strict cleanroom standards and ESD protection requirements.
